subject: iraceplot:  A Christmas gift from the irace team

messages.author: 854a0709976c2a48
messages.subject: iraceplot:  A Christmas gift from the irace team
parts:
Dear irace users,

We would like to wish you happy Christmas and the very best for the New Year and use this opportunity to announce the release of iraceplot 1.0 (https://auto-optimization.github.io/iraceplot/).

The iraceplot package provides different plots to visualize the data generated by irace.
In addition, it provides a report() function that creates a beautiful HTML report summarising many aspects of a single run of irace. See an example here: https://auto-optimization.github.io/iraceplot/articles/example/report_example.html

We hope it is useful!

Best wishes,

Manuel and Leslie.
